paper.title_en: Mirror symmetry for gCICY threefolds (I): a $[3,-1]$ block and a non-Gorenstein toric phase
paper.abstract_en: We construct and analyze a mirror family for the generalized complete intersection Calabi-Yau threefold $X_+=[\mathbb{P}^1\,|\,3\ {-1};\ \mathbb{P}^4\,|\,2\ 3]$, with $(h^{1,1},h^{2,1})=(2,46)$. We introduce auxiliary variables to obtain a toric GIT presentation with two chambers. The first gives $X_+$, while the second gives a Calabi-Yau threefold $X_-$ related to $X_+$ by a flop of 16 disjoint $(-1,-1)$-curves. The threefold $X_-$ is a nef complete intersection in a non-Gorenstein toric $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano eightfold. Then the Hori-Vafa equations give a 2-parameter Laurent family, and we construct a smooth projective crepant model $Y$ of its general member with mirrored Hodge numbers. The rank-6 Picard-Fuchs system of $Y$ has two maximally unipotent boundary points, whose indicial algebras are isomorphic to the even cohomology rings $H^{\mathrm{even}}(X_+,\mathbb{C})$ and $H^{\mathrm{even}}(X_-,\mathbb{C})$. We also show that the predicted genus-zero BPS numbers of the first two vertical degrees agree with direct counts of lines and conics on the genus-one fibration $X_-\to\mathbb{P}^2$.
